instruction: Complete the work through Abaqus via the Command Line Interface (CLI): perform a linear buckling analysis of a thin plate (Variant A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. Part: Create a 3D Deformable Shell, Planar part. Sketch a square plate from (0,0) to (96,96) in the X-Y plane. Property: Create a material named Steel. Set Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Homogeneous Shell Section with thickness = 1.2 mm and 5 integration points. Assign the shell section to the entire plate. Assembly: Create one dependent instance of the plate. Step: Create a Linear Perturbation > Buckle step named Step-Buckle-A. Request 3 eigenvalues. Mesh: Use global seed size = 6 mm. Use S4R shell elements. Generate the mesh. Load and Boundary Conditions: Represent the compressive edge load of 1.2 N/mm on the two vertical edges by equivalent nodal forces after meshing. On the X=0 edge, apply nodal forces in the +X direction. On the X=96 edge, apply nodal forces in the -X direction. Because the edge length is 96 mm and the mesh spacing is 6 mm, apply 7.2 N to each interior edge node and 3.6 N to each corner edge node on each loaded vertical edge. Apply U3 = 0 on all four plate edges: X=0, X=96, Y=0, and Y=96, to represent simply supported transverse conditions. Select the center mesh node at approximately (X=48, Y=48, Z=0) and apply U1 = U2 = 0 to suppress in-plane translational rigid-body motion. Select the bottom-edge midpoint mesh node at approximately (X=48, Y=0, Z=0) and apply U1 = 0 only to suppress the remaining in-plane rotational rigid-body mode. Job: Create Job-Buckle-A and submit it for solving. Visualization: Review the first buckling mode. Record the first eigenvalue. Save: Save the model database to C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Buckle-A.cae and ensure the output database is generated as C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Buckle-A.odb. [Software] To start Abaqus/CAE, run `C:\SIMULIA\CAE\2025LE\win_b64\resources\install\le\launcher.bat cae` (adjust path to your install). Before starting the work, Abaqus command-line jobs should be launched through `C:\SIMULIA\Commands\abaqus.bat`.
